title: Litematica Chest Supplier
description: Highlights chests containing materials needed by the current Litematica schematic and can automatically take the required items.
body:
# Litematica Chest Supplier

Litematica Chest Supplier is a client-side Fabric mod that helps players gather materials for building Litematica schematics.

## Features

* Detects missing materials required by the active schematic
* Finds tracked chests containing needed items
* Highlights useful chests in the world
* Automatically collects required materials from highlighted chests
* Highlights nearby missing block positions for carried materials
* Fully client-side operation

## Requirements

* Litematica
* MaLiLib
* Chest Tracker
* Fabric API
* Fabric Loader

## How It Works

1. Load a Litematica schematic.
2. The mod checks which materials are still needed.
3. Chests containing those materials are highlighted.
4. Look at a highlighted chest to automatically collect required items.
5. Continue building without manually searching storage systems.
